tuned_on_dev: Query strategy, candidate-pool size and optional reranking head selected by a development Recall@100/nDCG@100 sweep on the single labelled rear-lamp case
notes: Indexing, query planning and requirement generation never read gold answers. Gold page labels are used by the separate retrieval evaluator to select configuration. This is exploratory development performance, not held-out generalization. Claude generates and reviews requirement text; the leaderboard scores citations only.
generalization: No rear-lamp keyword rules or regulation allowlist are hard-coded in the solver; product-specific facets and scope are generated from the supplied specification. Unchanged execution on other products has not been tested.
robustness: Single development case only; no held-out evidence. Cross-experiment gains are confounded by packet count and extraction/review. High risk remains.
